sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, "county_public_safety"."Police_force" AS g, AVG((CAST(("city"."Hispanic" - "city"."White") AS REAL) / "city"."White")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "city" JOIN "county_public_safety" ON "county_public_safety"."County_ID" = "city"."County_ID"  GROUP BY "city"."County_ID", "county_public_safety"."Police_force"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: city.relative difference of share of population identifying as Hispanic from share of population identifying as White
why: (share of population identifying as Hispanic - share of population identifying as White) / share of population identifying as White: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of share of population identifying as Hispanic from share of population identifying as White per county_public_safety within county_public_safety.Police_force
share of the all total of number of city records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
